verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit is configured through a `.coderabbit.yaml` file kept in the repo, or centrally in an org-level `coderabbit` repository. Its settings include glob-based path instructions, the request_changes_workflow setting and auto-review rules (branches, drafts), and `@coderabbitai configuration` shows the resolved YAML. This covers the core of a versioned, in-repo reviewer configuration. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of path filters (excluding or including files from review), review profiles (e.g. assertive vs chill), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the config workflow.
